item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json,math\\nfrom work import evaluate\\nwith open('policy.json') as f: policy=json.load(f)\\nwith open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)\\nwith open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)\\nassert report == [evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]\\nprobes=[\\n ({'rows':[{'id':'a','amount':1},{'id':'a','amount':2}]},{'base_unit':'u','units':{'u':1},'unique':False},{'ok':True,'records':[{'id':'a','amount':1},{'id':'a','amount':2}],'errors':[]}),\\n ({'rows':[{'id':0,'amount':False,'unit':'bad'},{'id':'x','amount':False,'unit':'bad'},{'id':'y','amount':1,'unit':'bad'}]},{'base_unit':'u','units':{'u':1},'unique':True},{'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'id'},{'row':1,'cause':'amount'},{'row':2,'cause':'unit'}]}),\\n ({'rows':[{'id':'x','amount':-1},{'id':'x','amount':2},{'id':'x','amount':3}]},{'base_unit':'u','units':{'u':1},'unique':True},{'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'amount'},{'row':2,'cause':'duplicate'}]}),\\n ({'rows':[{'id':'','amount':1},{'id':'z','amount':float('inf')},{'id':'n','amount':float('nan')},{'id':'v','amount':0}]},{'base_unit':'u','units':{'u':2},'unique':False},{'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'id'},{'row':1,'cause':'amount'},{'row':2,'cause':'amount'}]})\\n]\\nfor i,(req,pol,want) in enumerate(probes):\\n rb=copy.deepcopy(req); pb=copy.deepcopy(pol); got=evaluate(req,pol)\\n assert got==want,(i,got,want); assert req==rb and pol==pb\\n assert set(got)=={'ok','records','errors'}\\n for rec in got['records']: assert set(rec)=={'id','amount'}\\n for err in got['errors']: assert set(err)=={'row','cause'}\\nprint(json.dumps({'report_matches':True,'boundary_probes':len(probes),'sample_result':report[0]}))\"]}"}
